definitions.gloss: cheerfully; brightly; with a refreshed feeling
definitions.explanation: Describes a feeling of relief, joy, or lightness, as if clouds have cleared and the sky is bright. Often used after worries have been resolved or a burden has been lifted.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}が{終|お}わって、{晴|は}れ{晴|ば}れとした{気分|きぶん}だ。
examples.english: The exam is over, and I feel so relieved.

examples.japanese: {晴|は}れ{晴|ば}れとした{笑顔|えがお}を{見|み}せた。
examples.english: She showed a bright, cheerful smile.

examples.japanese: {悩|なや}みが{解決|かいけつ}して{気持|きも}ちが{晴|は}れ{晴|ば}れした。
examples.english: My worries were resolved and I felt refreshed.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{晴|は}れ (clear weather, from {晴|は}れる) reduplicated.
The image is of clear, bright skies after clouds have passed.

FORMS:
・{晴|は}れ{晴|ば}れと (adverbial with と)
・{晴|は}れ{晴|ば}れとした + noun (adjectival)
・{晴|は}れ{晴|ば}れしい (i-adjective form, literary)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{晴|は}れ{晴|ば}れとした{気分|きぶん} - refreshed feeling
・{晴|は}れ{晴|ば}れとした{顔|かお} - bright face
・{晴|は}れ{晴|ば}れとした{表情|ひょうじょう} - cheerful expression
・{気持|きも}ちが{晴|は}れ{晴|ば}れする - to feel refreshed

SIMILAR WORDS:
・すっきり - refreshed, cleared up (more casual)
・さっぱり - refreshed, clean (after bathing/eating)
・{爽|さわ}やか - refreshing, fresh

REGISTER:
Neutral to slightly formal. Common in written and spoken Japanese.
